title: 2023年12月大学英语四级真题（第3套）
paperTitle: 2023年12月大学英语四级真题（第3套）
prompt: Suppose the university newspaper is inviting submissions from the students for its coming edition on what in their university impresses them most.You are now to write an essay for submission. You will have 30 minutes to write the essay. You should write at least 120 words but no more than 180 words.
reference: Among the many things on campus, it is the university library that has impressed me most. While my college offers modern labs and lively clubs, none of them stays in my heart as deeply as that quiet building. Quiet and well-lit, the library offers a space where I can truly focus and lose myself in books. Surrounded by towering shelves, I felt the joy of learning for the very first time. What touched me even more was a small experience. I still remember the day when I was searching desperately for an out-of-print book. It was a gentle old librarian who spent half an hour helping me track it down, which made me realize that this place is warmed not only by knowledge but also by kindness. Looking back, the library is more than a study room; it has taught me to seek knowledge actively rather than passively. That is why this quiet corner will always be the most unforgettable part of my university life.
keyPoints: 由泛收缩、一句亮主角。首段用 Among the many things on campus, it is the university library that has impressed me most 由校园万物收缩到图书馆一个对象并亮明态度，正面回应 what in their university impresses them most；再用 none of them stays in my heart as deeply 把『最』 写实。

氛围＋经历双层落实。主体段先用 Quiet and well-lit, the library offers a space 写氛围， 再用 I still remember the day when 引出找绝版书受馆员相助的经历，并以强调句＋定语从句 It was a gentle old librarian who ... which made me realize 升级表达，把它为何 impresses them most 写到 可感。
升华＋首尾呼应。结尾用 the library is more than a study room; it has taught me 由事及 己升华，再以 That is why this quiet corner will always be the most unforgettable part 回扣开头、 定格『最』。
